content.curriculum.age.little: Little · Ages 5–7: point, listen and say short phrases. Try a pretend conversation with a trusted adult.

content.curriculum.age.adult: Adult · Ages 18+: start with a short foundation task, then extend your replies for everyday life, travel and work.
